stops.title: Systems, properties, processes & PV work
stops.inShort: Extensive properties depend on amount of matter (mass, V, U, H); intensive properties do not (T, P, density). IUPAC sign convention: work done ON system is +W, BY system is −W: W = −P_ext ΔV.

stops.title: Maximum work & First law of thermodynamics
stops.inShort: Maximum work in isothermal reversible expansion: W_max = −2.303 n R T log₁₀(V₂/V₁) = −2.303 n R T log₁₀(P₁/P₂). First law: ΔU = Q + W.

stops.title: Enthalpy, ΔH vs ΔU & Thermochemistry
stops.inShort: Enthalpy H = U + PV; ΔH = ΔU + Δn_g R T. Hess's law: overall enthalpy change is independent of path. Δ_r H° = ∑Δ_f H°(products) − ∑Δ_f H°(reactants).

stops.title: Entropy, Second law & Gibbs energy (spontaneity)
stops.inShort: Entropy S is a measure of disorder (ΔS_total = ΔS_sys + ΔS_surr > 0 for spontaneous process). Gibbs energy G = H − TS; at constant T, P: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS (< 0 spontaneous, = 0 equilibrium, > 0 non-spontaneous).

items.f: W_max = −2.303 n R T log₁₀(V₂ / V₁)
ΔG = ΔH − T ΔS,  ΔG° = −2.303 R T log₁₀ K

board.text: The value of Δn_g for the oxidation of 4 mole of sulphur dioxide to sulphur trioxide is ____.
Calculate the work done in kJ in a reaction, if volume of the reactant decreases from 8 dm³ to 4 dm³ against 43 bar pressure. [1 dm³·bar = 100 J]
ΔH for formation of ethane gas is −84.4 kJ at 300 K. Calculate ΔU for the reaction.
board.answer:
Reaction: 2 C(s) + 3 H₂(g) → C₂H₆(g).
Δn_g = 1 − 3 = −2 mol.
ΔH = ΔU + Δn_g R T ⇒ ΔU = ΔH − Δn_g R T
= −84.4 kJ − (−2)(8.314 × 10⁻³ kJ/mol·K)(300 K)
= −84.4 + 4.988 = −79.41 kJ.

board.text: Derive an expression for maximum work obtainable during isothermal reversible expansion of an ideal gas from initial volume (V₁) to final volume (V₂).
board.answer:
For an infinitesimally small reversible expansion dV against external pressure P_ext = P − dP ≈ P:
dW = −P dV.
Integrating from V₁ to V₂ and using PV = nRT:
W_max = −∫(V₁ to V₂) (nRT/V) dV = −nRT ln(V₂/V₁) = −2.303 nRT log₁₀(V₂/V₁).
